description: Book a same-day courier delivery on a Comet account. Call first without confirm to get a preview (price, vehicle, pickup time); show it to your user; then call again with the same details and confirm=true to place the order. Returns the Comet order number. Needs the client's Comet account key (Authorization: Bearer cmt_...). Account holders get one from Comet at (312) 786-2288.

confirm.description: false/omitted = preview only (price and details, nothing booked). true = place the order. Always show the preview to your user before confirming.

dropoff_name.description: Company or person receiving the delivery

dropoff_notes.description: Instructions for the courier at drop-off

dropoff_street.description: Drop-off street address, e.g. '300 N LaSalle St'

notify_email.description: Email for the order confirmation and delivery notice

ordered_by.description: Name of the person the agent is acting for

pickup_name.description: Company or person at pickup. Omit pickup fields entirely to pick up at the account's own office.

pickup_notes.description: Instructions for the courier at pickup

pickup_street.description: Pickup street address, e.g. '300 N LaSalle St'

reference.description: Client reference / matter number for the invoice

round_trip.description: True when the courier returns to the pickup (default false)

service.description: Streak (fastest, about 1-2 h), Priority (about 2-3 h) or Standard (about 4-6 h). Only the services on the account are accepted.

vehicle.description: Vehicle wanted; 'auto' (default) picks from the weight. A heavier load is moved up to the vehicle it needs.

weight_lb.description: Total weight in pounds. Picks the vehicle when none is given.

when.description: 'now' (default) or a pickup time in Chicago time today or tomorrow, e.g. '2026-10-13T09:00'. Further ahead: call the office.

name: book_delivery

estimated_price.description: List-rate estimate; the account's own rate applies on the invoice

order_number.description: Comet / Xcelerator tracking number once entered, e.g. '516.101226'

placed.description: True only when a real order was created

title: Book a Comet delivery (account holders)
